verdict.rationale: Fedora Workstation is a desktop Linux distribution, and subscribing to events through registrable outbound HTTP webhooks is a SaaS or service-platform capability, not an axis desktop operating systems are compared on. Nothing in the evidence shows Fedora shipping any webhook mechanism that would make the axis apply. The Do Not Disturb notification setting is a desktop UI control, not a webhook, and gets no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
